choices.detail: Raw is a 6-card slider (image + h3 title + link, no body text). No block supports an image-card grid; mapped the whole section to ONE servicePair: heading = section h2 "Dành cho mọi Doanh Nghiệp", body = section h5 intro, bullets = the 6 card titles (verbatim), image = the first card image. Card hrefs exist in the site nav; the 5 remaining card images are not referenced (they also exist on their target pages).
Post thumbnails/excerpts in the news section are Posts data (M3) — only the section heading and "Xem tất cả" href are ported; the "Xem tất cả bài viết" label is not a newsPreview field.

Raw shows 8 package cards (HD300…HD100000), not an mgp-price-table. Mapped to one pricingTable block: one group per package (group title = package code, row service = "Số lượng hoá đơn : N" line, fee = price). The per-card "Miễn phí khởi tạo" / "Miễn phí lưu trữ 10 năm" lines are identical on all 8 cards and are carried once in pricingTable.note.

Raw contains 16 partner-service cards (h3 + description paragraph), not 22 as estimated in the task brief; all 16 are ported verbatim as featureGrid items. No pricing, FAQ or logos exist on this raw page.

Raw shows 3 team members (Nguyễn Minh Trí, Lê Thanh Hoa, Phạm Anh Quân); only the first two exist as Authors (Task 12) — teamGrid links those two. Phạm Anh Quân has no Author record (no photo/credentials captured); flagged for the client to add an Author if wanted. Member photos (mbws-avatar-*.jpg) are not downloaded.
A full-width background-image banner with no HTML text content — no block can hold it; not ported.

The CF7 contact form is M3 scope (Leads) — not ported. The three contact boxes are ported as a richText block with "label: value" lines assembled from the raw h3 labels and values. ctaBanner carries the section heading/intro; its ctaLabel/ctaHref are left to the schema defaults ("Liên hệ ngay" → /lien-he/).

Where a price-table package cell carries a ux-menu feature list (thanh-lap, ho-tro), the features are joined with "; " into the row service text (all values verbatim); group title = package name, fee = price. ke-toan tabs become pricingTable groups titled by tab label; the per-tab h5 notes are combined into pricingTable.note with "label — note" lines.

Every page's "Khách Hàng Của…" section contains counters (8+/140+/700+/99% + labels), not quotes — no testimonials exist anywhere in the raws, so no testimonials block is seeded. Counters map to richText [bold-p(h2), p(intro)] + featureGrid [items {title: count, body: label}].

Small h6 kickers above section headings (e.g. "DỊCH VỤ", "Bảng giá", "8 NĂM ĐỒNG HÀNH", "GIỚI THIỆU", "ĐỊNH NGŨ") have no block field except ctaBanner.eyebrow (used where present: "Contact", "GIẢI PHÁP PHÁP LÝ NHANH CHÓNG!"); they are otherwise not ported. The h2 section headings themselves are preserved.
Service-page heroes have no button in the raw; ctaLabel "Liên hệ ngay" + ctaHref "/lien-he/" follow the task example fixture and match the site header button (raw HTML text).

img-blog-11.jpg is the hero background on 4 pages (thanh-lap, hoa-don, chu-ky, dich-vu-lien-ket) and has an empty alt in every raw; it gets one neutral alt "Dịch vụ pháp lý của Luật Gia Trí" (derived from the nav "Dịch vụ" + brand). Media dedupes by URL.

Section background images (mgp-people-3.png, mgp-people-2.png, bgn-*.jpg/png) are decorative Flatsome backgrounds with no alt and no block field for backgrounds; not ported. thanh-lap's FAQ decorative image (img-blog-12-1024x1024.jpg) likewise has no block slot; not ported.

Per spec §6.4 the Heading component is the only h2/h3 emitter in blocks, so section headings that fall inside richText bodies (e.g. "Mô tả dịch vụ kế toán thuế", stats-section h2s, gioi-thieu h2 pairs) are stored as bold paragraphs in the Lexical body instead of heading nodes. Text is verbatim. RULE — Lexical bold = "format": 1; "bold": true is silently ignored (both the JSX and HTML text converters read node.format and never a "bold" property). Every fixture originally carried the inert "bold": true and rendered as plain text; the M3 Task 7 follow-up converted all runs (14 across the 7 M2 fixtures, plus the 9 chinh-sach-bao-mat headings) to "format": 1.

serviceMeta.icon is populated from the home service-card image of the matching service (alt = the card h3 title, verbatim). ho-tro-doanh-nghiep uses its first card ("THAY ĐỔI THÔNG TIN DOANH NGHIỆP"); dich-vu-lien-ket has no card on home and gets null.
Fixtures carry "_status": "published" so the draft-enabled Pages records are queryable by Task 21's published-only getPage().

Raw rows carry THREE fee columns (Token / Dịch vụ / Duy trì) plus a computed total (Tổng₫) per 1-2-3 (NCCA: 4) năm term — the pricingTable (service, term?, fee) row cannot carry one raw row, so the dedicated tokenMatrix block was created (the spec §5.5 contingency). 15 sections = 7 provider tabs (FPT, VINA, NCCA, CA2-CA, VIETTEL, VNPT, EASY-CA); FPT has two variants (enterprise + "Dành cho khách hàng cá nhân", from the raw button label); 46 term rows. Column geometry mirrors the raw header exactly: [section h3 (Đăng ký mới/Gia hạn), Token, Dịch vụ, Duy trì, Tổng₫]. Extraction was programmatic (cheerio in temp tooling outside the repo, Task 20 discipline); 65 empty raw cells are ported as "–" placeholders (required text fields reject empty strings), the remaining 240 values byte-verbatim (240 = 230 cells + 75 column labels − 65 placeholders), verified programmatically. Section-title redundancy: the raw table's first column header repeats the section h3 term ("Đăng ký mới"/"Gia hạn") — the section h3 IS the first column header on the live site — so each section's title is stored as "<provider> — <term>" while its first column carries the bare term. The repeated "* Đơn giá đã bao gồm VAT" row (after every table) is carried once in tokenMatrix.note.

headingRewording.why: primaryHeading is authored SEO H1 copy (spec §6.4/§6.9), not ported body text; the M2 capture lifted the WordPress page titles, which embed the brand — the brand belongs in the title suffix, not the H1. Home was the last exception (its H1 kept the "Luật Gia Trí - " prefix); on 2026-10-01 the client chose the shorter H1 ("Công Ty Tư Vấn Thành Lập Doanh Nghiệp, Kế Toán, Báo Cáo Thuế"), so the brand now lives only in the title/schema — home is no longer special-cased in pageMetadata.
